channel.title: Ragmop and Goose
channel.description: We are Puppet Conservationists on a mission to revive the art and love of puppetry worldwide for people of all ages! We post videos of our puppets' adventures, puppet-making challenges, and vlogs that show a BTS glimpse of what it's like to run a business like ours.

videos.t: I made a Live-Hand Puppet for the first time!
videos.desc:
Meet my new friend, Walnut! He's a live hand puppet and I just so happened to film his birth via timelapse! 

Materials used:
Faux Fur
X-Acto Knife
Scissors
Hot Glue
Velcro Dots
Felt
Sewing Machine (Brother XL 2600i)
Needle & Thread
Foam
Plastic eyes from www.glasseyesonline.com

I used the Big Mack pattern from Adam Kruetinger! Big shout out to him because he's an incredible puppet maker and I've learned a lot from his videos. Check out his website and his channel for more info on puppet making! https://www.adamkreutinger.com/
https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCJJ8gXdnTFLLHzRnWxIIaSA

Where to

Tuna has been asking and asking when she could start her own vlog after watching countless vlogs by Cheyenne Barton and Frannerd. I finally gave her permission to start one (with the help of her dad, since I'm always busy working)! We all hope you enjoy it! 

You can see more of Tuna and our puppet family on our puppet Instagrams!
https://www.Instagram.com/turkeyslunchbox
https://www.Instagram.com/tunalunasandwich

You can see exclusive behind the scenes footage on the filming process for this video by supporting me on Patreon! 
https://www.patreon.com/jessieshungry

Where to keep up with me:

videos.t: Walnut Teaches Everything and Nothing | Official Trailer | MasterClass
videos.desc:
Walnut is a jack of all trades and knows everything about nothing. In this class, you will learn things. Not saying they will be useful things. But they will be things that you learn. 

In 23+ hours of video lessons, Walnut teaches:
• How to make macaroni 
• How to cut wood
• How to turn on the lights
• How to make a 18th century antique coo-coo clock
• How to craft your craft
• Soap
• How to get the perfect litter scoop
• How to not pet a cat
• How to replace your RAM on your Windows 98 laptop
• How to play tennis
• How to use Mapquest
• How to improve your credit score
• How to toast waffles

Come hang out with Gus and me while we try to figure out how to turn common household items into new friends!

Materials we used for the puppets ended up making:
Scissors
Hot glue
Paper Plates
Plastic Spoons
Wine Corks
Solo Cups
Rubber Bands
A Sock
Polyfil 
Chopsticks 
Chip Clips
Ribbon

videos.desc:
Pinky is off to fulfill his life's purpose of helping someone with their creativity and self-expression! We can't wait to see all the adventures they go on together! 

We are puppet conservationists on a mission to revive the art of puppetry, so we clone puppets in our lab and help them find their forever homes!

If you're looking for a puppet companion, come meet our puppets at www.ragmopandgoose.com!

Ragmop and Goose face off in an epic puppet-making competition where they can only use materials from the thrift store! They have 90 minutes to create their masterpieces and the results are amazing. Our Patreon supporters voted and crowned the winner! Who do you think won? Check out the full video to find out!

videos.t: The 48 Hour Rube Goldberg Machine Competition Festival (a short film)
videos.desc:
This was our submission for the 48 Hour Puppet Film Project 2026, presented by Handmade Puppet Dreams & Green Feather Foundation. The word prompts this year were:

Theme: Movement
Action: Nudge
Item: Wood

Technically, we did this in under 24 hours because we had to teach a puppet-making workshop that weekend! We started filming at 7pm on Saturday and didn't finish until 6am, then spent the rest of Sunday editing as much as we could! We got maybe 2 hours of sleep, haha! What a wonderful adventure it was!
